name: Kwia Vigorbloom
description: School of Invasive Healing at Hexhaven Academy on the Echoverse version of Arcavios, counterpart of Witherbloom.

timeline.summary: The five Founder Sphinxes, created at Arcavios's largest leyline confluence, found Hexhaven to share magic with the plane's denizens.
timeline.quote: With the other four sphinxes, they helped found Hexhaven, sharing their knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world.
